name: Deployment problem
about: Report a build, launch, kernel or inference problem
title: ''

---

Describe the expected behavior and what happened.

Include the source revisions, actual image ID, Spark/driver versions, selected profile, failing command, and relevant error trace. For distributed problems, include every rank's outcome and the observed NCCL transport.

Remove login names, private host addresses, tokens, model prompts and other private data from shared logs.

State which preflight, kernel, collective and inference checks passed before the failure.
